battle.name: 隋煬帝第三次攻高麗之戰
battle.brief: 大業十年（614）正月，隋煬帝再集天下雄兵百十三萬五千人，糧運人力倍之，二月分道出師，第三次進攻高句麗。隋軍突破鴨綠水前線卻未能攻下平壤，糧道屢遭游騎截斷，最後在高句麗遣使請和後撤軍。卡面的羅馬弩砲是公元前一世紀的扭力弩機，與隋軍弩砲、砲車同屬投射型攻城器械，形制全然不同。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 大業十年（614）第三次征討高句麗，是隋朝與高句麗之間的一次邊境大戰，交戰地帶由柳城、遼東一路延伸至鴨綠水與平壤外圍。隋軍一方由隋煬帝楊廣下詔調集，以宇文述為行軍元帥，于仲文、樊子蓋等分將各道，並遣使結好東突厥，企圖以北方騎兵配合，夾擊高句麗的側背。隋軍編制沿用大業八年的舊制，分為數十道，兵員雜以郡縣鄉兵、屯田兵與京師宿衛，糧秣由河北、山東與江南沿漕運及陸路北運，運力倍於兵員。高句麗一方由國王高元坐鎮平壤，統轄渤海、遼東與高句麗諸部，軍隊依山城、險隘與城邑分屯布防，以弓弩、落石、拒馬硬守，騎兵則不斷出擊隋軍的糧道與輜重隊。整體看，這是一場王朝總力對一國地勢的消耗戰：隋朝出動的是全國性兵員與後勤體系，高句麗投入的是本土防禦與流動打擊，雙方的力量結構從開戰第一日便不對等。漢文史料另載，隋朝在攻勢之外還經營高句麗與東突厥、室韋之間的外交，想以聯手制裁分擔戰場負擔，但高句麗與北方部族之間的往來從未真正被切斷，隋朝的外交努力只換來了邊境上更多而不是更少的牽制。
countriesEn: The third Sui campaign against Goguryeo of 614 CE was a large border war between the Sui dynasty and the kingdom of Goguryeo, with the theatre running from Niucheng and Liaodong in the north-east up to the Yalu river and the approaches to Pyongyang. On the Sui side, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the mustering, appointed Yuwen Shu as the chief commander of the expedition, gave Yu Zhongwen, Fan Zigan and others separate columns to lead, and sent envoys to the Eastern Turkic Khaganate in the hope of pinning Goguryeo's northern flank with Turkic cavalry. The Sui army followed the organisation already used in 612: it was split into several dozen columns drawing on commandery and county levies, garrison and farm troops and the capital's guard, while grain and provisions were moved north from Hebei, Shandong and Jiangnan by waterway and by road, with transport capacity counted at twice the size of the army. Goguryeo was commanded by its king Go-won, seated at Pyongyang, and ruled the peoples of the Paechi, Liaodong and the northern peninsula; its forces were posted in mountain fortresses, at passes and in walled towns, held the line with bows and crossbows, stone drops and caltrops, and used cavalry to keep striking at the Sui supply lines and baggage trains. In structural terms this was a war of a dynasty's total national strength against one country's terrain: the Sui brought the manpower and the logistics of the whole empire, Goguryeo brought local defence and mobile harassment, and the two were never evenly matched from the first day of the war. Chinese sources also record that alongside the offensive the Sui court worked the diplomatic channel with Goguryeo, the Eastern Turks and the Xianbei, hoping to share the burden of the battlefield through combined sanctions, but the contacts between Goguryeo and the northern peoples were never truly severed: the Sui diplomacy bought it more distraction on the frontier, not less.
people: 隋煬帝楊廣是這場戰爭的決策者，也是前兩次失敗的直接受害者。大業八年首次征討，他以百餘萬大軍壓境，卻在鴨綠水與薩水折損殆盡；大業九年再征，兵困平壤之圍不得下，回師途中軍心崩潰，怨言四起。為雪前恥、也為平定楊玄感起義後的邊患，他在大業十年正月第三次下詔徵兵，親自督戰於前線，宇文述總統行軍，于仲文、樊子蓋等分道主軍，後方則由戶部與諸道州郡籌措糧秣。高句麗方面，國王高元是主政者，他並不拒絕交涉，卻始終不願稱臣；大業十年高句麗主動遣使請和，並把楊玄感部將斛斯政送還隋朝，這是全役唯一一次實質的外交動作。隋朝接受請和、罷兵之後，高元沒有依約出城謁見，隋煬帝為此大怒，諸臣苦勸才止住再度東征的念頭。斛斯政因此成為本役的關鍵人物：既是上一次內亂留下的活口，也是這場邊境戰爭得以暫時收束的媒介。漢文史料所見的高句麗將領如麴達之輩，多以據險拒守、避實擊虛見稱，其姓名與部署在唐宋以前的記載中已多湮沒，反倒是隋方將領的姓名流傳較廣，於仲文每戰身先士卒、樊子蓋治軍嚴整的形象，至今仍能從斷簡殘篇中勾勒出來。
peopleEn: Emperor Yang of Sui was the decision-maker in this war and also the direct victim of the two earlier defeats. In 612, his first campaign pushed more than a million men across the border only to bleed out at the Yalu and the Sasu; in 613 he came back with a smaller force, was unable to take Pyongyang, and saw the army disintegrate on the line of march. To wipe out that disgrace, and to settle the frontier after the revolt of Yang Xuangan, he issued the third call for troops in the first month of the tenth year of Daye, directed the war in person from the front, put Yuwen Shu in overall command of the march, gave Yu Zhongwen, Fan Zigan and others separate columns, and left the raising of grain and provisions to the Ministry of Revenue and the commanderies of the various circuits. On the Goguryeo side the ruler was King Go-won, who was not unwilling to negotiate but was never prepared to acknowledge Sui overlordship; in 614 Goguryeo sent an envoy to sue for peace and returned Husi Zheng, a general of Yang Xuangan who had fled north, and that was the only substantive diplomatic move of the whole campaign. After the Sui accepted the peace and stood the army down, Go-won did not come out of the city to pay the court as agreed, and Emperor Yang was furious; only the entreaties of his ministers stopped him from marching east once more. Husi Zheng is therefore the pivotal person of this campaign: at once the living remainder of the last civil disturbance and the medium through which the border war was briefly brought to a close. The Goguryeo commanders named in Chinese sources, men such as Mo Da, are remembered for holding difficult ground and striking where the enemy was weak, and their names and dispositions have largely been lost since the Tang and Song; it is the Sui commanders whose names survive, and one can still reconstruct from scattered fragments the picture of Yu Zhongwen riding at the head of his men and Fan Zigan holding the army with strict discipline.
kits: 卡面上的羅馬弩砲（Scorpio），是公元前一世紀起羅馬軍團裝備的扭力弩機：木製機身以多股皮條或絞繩蓄力，鋼製或青銅製的弩臂把蓄滿的扭力轉化為一發弩矢的動能，射程約在數百步上下，可用來在攻城戰中以直射火力壓制城頭、封鎖城門缺口，羅馬人自己稱它為「蠍子」。必須說明的是，這件兵器與本役並無任何考古或文獻上的聯繫：羅馬弩砲未曾傳入東亞，中原同時期的攻城與野戰重器材是弩砲（以絞弦弩機發射的巨型弩）、砲（配皮筋或繩索的配重投石機）、巢車、雲梯、撞車與飛雲梯一類，隋軍自幽州、柳城一線隨軍攜帶，並在野戰中就地架設與修補。隋軍的個人裝備仍以弓箭、槊、矟、橫刀與甲冑為主，攻城所需的重型器械則靠大批工匠、繩索、木料與車輛隨軍運送。高句麗方面的防禦器材以山城石壘、壕溝、壘壁與木柵為主，弓弩手居高臨下射擊，另有落石與拒馬阻道，騎兵配以弓箭與短兵，備著從山道搶出的馬匹與糧秣。雙方的火力核心其實都是弩與投石，只不過羅馬把扭力集中在弩機的簧臂上，中原則更多依靠人力絞弦與配重；兩者的射程、射速、機體壽命與野外維修條件都相差甚遠，而真正決定本役勝負的，是誰能把投射器械與糧道一起送到前線。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on the card is a torsion-powered bolt thrower that Roman legions were using from the first century BC: a wooden frame wound with skeins of hide or twisted cord, whose steel or bronze arms turn the stored tension into the momentum of a single bolt, with an effective range of some few hundred paces, used in siege work to shoot directly over the wall and to seal gaps in a gate; the Romans themselves called it the scorpion. It has to be said that this weapon has no archaeological or documentary connection whatsoever with the present campaign: the Roman scorpio never reached East Asia. The heavy siege and field artillery of the Chinese plain at this time was the crossbow-thrower (a huge crossbow worked by a winched bowstring), the stone-thrower (a counterweight trebuchet on hide or rope), the siege tower, the scaling ladder, the battering ram and the flying ladder, all of which the Sui army carried with it from the Youzhou and Niucheng lines and erected and repaired on the spot in the field. The personal equipment of the Sui soldier remained bows and crossbows, the sao spear, the ji spear, the heng dao sabre and armour, while the heavy machines needed for the siege travelled with the column as bulk, together with the craftsmen, rope, timber and wagons they required. On the Goguryeo side the defensive works were stone works on the hills, ditches, ramparts and wooden palisades, with archers firing from the heights, stone drops and caltrops blocking the roads, and cavalry equipped with bow, arrow and short weapons, with horses and provisions taken from the mountain tracks. The real core of firepower on both sides was in fact the bow and the thrown stone; the difference is that Rome concentrated its stored energy in the arms of the bolt machine, while China relied more on human winching and on counterweight. The ranges, rates of fire, service life of the frames and the conditions of field maintenance differ greatly between the two, and what really decided this campaign was who could get the artillery and the grain route to the front line together.
tactics: 與大業八年那場傾國之力直取平壤的打法相比，第三次征討的戰術重心明顯轉移。隋軍不再把全部主力壓縮成一條攻擊軸線，而是分成數十道分進：一部分進抵鴨綠水，攻擊前線山城與要塞；一部分就地抄掠、斷絕高句麗的丁口與糧道，企圖以持久戰耗盡對方；同時在遼東、柳城一線築城屯糧，把糧秣轉運線盡量維持在身後，並在鴨綠水東岸預築營壘與囤積點。攻城時仍循中國式的常法：先以弩砲與砲的投射火力覆蓋城頭與城門，逼退守兵，再由填壕、架雲梯的工兵逼近，或以撞車衝擊城門。問題在於高句麗並不與隋軍硬拼攻城：其主力退守平壤及周邊險要山地，避開隋軍鋒芒，以游騎不斷切斷糧道、夜襲營壘與輜重隊，使隋軍每一次推進都要付出不成比例的代價。隋軍在遼東的補給線越長，這種截擊就越有效。當糧秣耗盡、久雨困營、士氣崩潰之際，隋軍只能退兵，而撤退序列一旦被咬住，殿軍往往承受最大損失。高句麗最終以「不求勝、但求拖」的方式拖垮了第三次遠征，也第一次讓隋廷明白，平壤不是靠一次總攻就能拿下的城池。
tacticsEn: Compared with the attempt in 612, which hurled the whole national strength straight at Pyongyang, the third campaign of 614 visibly shifted its tactical centre of gravity. The Sui no longer compressed its entire main force onto a single axis of attack, but split it into several dozen columns that advanced separately: some pushed up to the Yalu and attacked the frontier mountain fortresses and blockhouses; some stayed where they were to raid, to cut the lines of food and to carry off the population of Goguryeo, hoping to wear the enemy down in a war of attrition; and at the same time depots and stockades were built along the Liaodong and Niucheng lines, so that the grain route could be kept as far behind the fighting as possible, with fortified camps and supply dumps prepared in advance on the eastern bank of the Yalu. Siege work still followed the Chinese convention: the wall and the gate were first covered by the fire of the crossbow-throwers and the stone-throwers, to drive the defenders off the parapet, and only then did the engineer troops fill the ditches and set up their ladders, or bring the rammers against the gates. The difficulty was that Goguryeo did not meet the Sui in a straight fight for the walls: its main strength withdrew to Pyongyang and the strongholds in the hills around it, avoiding the Sui edge, and used its light horse to cut the supply line, to raid the camps by night and to fall upon the baggage trains, so that every step forward cost the Sui a disproportionate amount. The longer the Sui supply line across Liaodong, the more effective that interdiction became. When grain ran out, the rains set in and the army's morale broke, the Sui could do nothing but withdraw, and once a column of retreat was caught, the rearguard invariably took the heaviest losses. In the end Goguryeo defeated the third expedition by the method of refusing to win but insisting on dragging: it was also the first time the Sui court understood that Pyongyang could not be taken by a single general assault.
data: 兵員方面，漢文史料記載這次大軍為百十三萬五千人，糧運人力倍之；前一戰的數字可作對照：《隋書·煬帝紀》記大業八年出兵「總一百一十三萬三千八百，號二百萬，其餽運者倍之」，渡遼河作戰者約三十五萬人，返抵者僅二千七百人，《隋書》另記此役隋軍損失三十餘萬；大業九年第二次出兵只有十一萬三千人，圍平壤數十餘日不能下，潰敗之後損折過半。上述數字多為官方宣稱，實際點驗與逃亡難以核實，學界多認為大業八年一役實到兵力在數十萬量級，有學者估計為六十七萬人左右。距離方面，自柳城、幽州至鴨綠水前線的運糧線長逾千里，平壤距遼陽約五百餘里；騎兵一日可達三四百里，隋軍糧隊需車載糧、日行數十里，遇上泥濘便要停滯。器械方面，弩砲的有效射程約在數百步，投石砲的拋程約在數百步至一里上下；羅馬弩砲的射程與之相當，但其問世早了一千六百餘年，與本役並無關聯。時間上，大業十年正月下詔、二月出師，戰事延續至夏秋，糧盡退兵在秋冬之際，至年底方回抵京師，而本役的損失在漢文記載中沒有留下可核的數目，只能從退兵時的慘狀與此後再無力東征兩點反推。
dataEn: On numbers: the Chinese records give this expedition as one million, one hundred and thirty-five thousand men, with the transport of grain and the labour that went with it at twice that figure; the figures of the preceding campaigns make a useful contrast. The Book of Sui records that in 612 the host totalled one million, one hundred and thirty-three thousand eight hundred men, proclaimed as two hundred thousand, with the baggage and provisions doubled again, that about three hundred and fifty thousand crossed the Liao river to fight, and that only two thousand seven hundred came back, the Book of Sui elsewhere putting the Sui losses in that campaign at more than three hundred thousand; in 613 the second expedition numbered only one hundred and thirteen thousand men, lay around Pyongyang for several tens of days without taking it, and lost more than half its strength in the rout. Most of these are official declarations, impossible to check against the rolls and against the deserters, and most scholars now hold that the real strength present in 612 was in the hundreds of thousands, one estimate putting it at six hundred and seventy thousand. On distance: the grain route from Niucheng and Youzhou to the Yalu front ran for more than a thousand li, and Pyongyang stands a little over five hundred li from Liaoyang; a mounted column could cover three or four hundred li a day, while the Sui grain wagons were limited to a few tens of li, and stopped dead in mud. On machinery: the crossbow-throwers had a useful range of a few hundred paces and the stone-throwers a throw of from a few hundred paces to about a li; the Roman scorpio had a comparable range, but it had appeared some sixteen centuries earlier and has no bearing on this campaign. On time: the call for troops was issued in the first month of the tenth year of Daye, the columns marched in the second, the fighting ran through the summer and autumn, the army withdrew for want of grain in the autumn and winter, and the host was back at the capital only by the year's end; the losses of this campaign left no verifiable figure in the Chinese texts, and can only be inferred from the state of the retreating army and from the fact that the Sui never again had the strength to march east.
cause: 要理解第三次征討為何會打成這樣，先要看隋朝與高句麗之間那條始終沒有拉直的線。隋文帝開皇年間完成統一之後，把高句麗視為東北最後一個不臣的政權：開皇十六年（596）隋朝致書高句麗，要求其斷絕與北方突厥的往來、停止越境抄掠，並正式臣服於隋；高句麗則在開皇十七年（597）與靺鞨部聯兵反攻幽州，攻破隋朝邊郡。開皇二十年（598）隋文帝以三十萬大軍、命晉王楊廣與並州總管楊素等攻高句麗，無功而還，這次失敗已埋下日後報復的種子。隋煬帝即位後，把征高句麗當作洗刷國恥與建立個人威權的雙重工程：大業八年傾國而出，慘敗於薩水；大業九年再舉，兵困平壤而潰，楊玄感同時在黎陽起兵，煬帝被迫回師平叛，無論從雪恥、抑或從消滅東北邊患、穩住剛被平定的高句麗與突厥邊境來看，第三次出征都無法迴避。真正讓衝突升級的，是高句麗不願稱臣而隋煬帝又亟欲速勝的心態：他不接受任何保留實力的妥協，把一場本可長期消耗的邊境較量，變成了必須速戰速決的三度遠征。
causeEn: To understand why the third campaign came out as it did, one must first look at the line between the Sui and Goguryeo that was never pulled straight. After completing the unification under the Kaihuang reign, the Sui treated Goguryeo as the last unsubject state in the north-east: in 596 Emperor Wen sent a letter demanding that Goguryeo break off its dealings with the Turks of the north, stop raiding across the border, and formally acknowledge Sui overlordship; Goguryeo answered in 597 by joining with the Mohe in an offensive against Youzhou that broke through Sui border commanderies. In 598 Emperor Wen sent three hundred thousand men, with the Prince of Jin Yang Guang and the Bingzhou commander Yang Su, against Goguryeo, and returned without success — a failure that planted the seed of the revenge to come. Once Yang Guang took the throne, the campaign against Goguryeo became a double project: wiping out a national disgrace and building up his own authority. In 612 he emptied the country into the field and was destroyed at the Sasu; in 613 he raised another army, was stalled at Pyongyang and broke, and while he was away Yang Xuangan rose at Liyang, forcing him to turn back and put down the revolt. From the point of view of revenge, or of removing the last frontier thorn and stabilising the newly quieted Goguryeo-Turkish border, the third expedition could not be avoided. What actually raised the temperature was the collision between Goguryeo's refusal to acknowledge overlordship and Emperor Yang's need for a quick victory: he would not accept any compromise that left real strength intact, and turned a border contest that could have been drawn out into a third expedition that had to be won quickly.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接結果是又一次失敗，但它造成的後果遠比前兩次更深遠。首先是國力的空虛：連續三年、合計數百萬人次的徵發，與倍於兵員的糧運，把河北、山東、江南的丁口與漕運秩序反覆抽取，隋朝以括戶的方式重新核定人頭以保證軍糧，役繁而賦重，社會機器在開皇末年的寬政之後急轉直下。此役之後，各地反隋的抗爭由零星的流民暴動變成連綿不絕的起事，州縣守令各自為政，隋朝的號令在關東與江南越來越難以貫徹，楊廣本人也再無餘裕收拾局面。其次是戰略與外交的轉向：高句麗用一次成功的拖延證明，只要據險不出、專斷糧道，就足以拖垮隋朝傾國之師；隋朝自此放棄立刻滅高句麗的想法，把北方重心轉向突厥，煬帝隨後西征啟民可汗，反而招來突厥大軍反攻塞下，隋朝被迫在南北兩個戰場同時防守，國力消耗得更快。第三是長期的邊疆格局：高句麗得以在隋亡之後繼續以半獨立的姿態存在，與隋、唐、突厥三方周旋多年，直到唐高宗總章元年（668）才被唐軍攻滅，成為東北亞局勢長期變化的伏線，而隋唐之際那十餘年的高句麗獨立時期，正是這段長期格局的開端。
impactEn: The immediate result of this war was another failure, but its consequences ran much deeper than those of the two earlier campaigns. First came the exhaustion of national strength: three consecutive years of mustering, millions of men in total, and grain transport at twice the size of the armies repeatedly drained the populations and the grain traffic of Hebei, Shandong and Jiangnan, and the Sui re-registered households by a survey in order to guarantee military grain; with the corvée heavy and the taxation onerous, the social machine that had run leniently in the late Kaihuang years turned sharply downward. After this campaign the resistances against the Sui in the provinces changed from scattered disturbances by displaced peasants into a continuous series of risings, local governors acted on their own, and the Sui's orders penetrated the eastern provinces and the south with steadily less success; Yang Guang himself had no reserves left to clean up the situation. Second came the shift in strategy and diplomacy: Goguryeo proved by one successful dragging campaign that merely holding the strong ground and cutting the supply lines was enough to exhaust a Sui army sent with the whole empire, and the Sui abandoned the idea of destroying Goguryeo at once and swung the northern weight of the empire towards the Turks; the ensuing westward campaign against Qimin Khagan brought a Turkic host back over the frontier in reply, and the Sui was forced to defend in the north and the south at the same time, spending its strength even faster. Third came the long-term frontier pattern: Goguryeo was able to survive the fall of the Sui as a half-independent power, manoeuvring for years between Sui, Tang and Turkic rivals, and was finally destroyed by Tang armies in 668 under Emperor Gaozong; the independent decades of Goguryeo between Sui and Tang are the opening of that long pattern, and the campaign of 614 is one of the hinges of it.
result: 打完了：隋朝第三次征討高句麗，以撤軍收場，而不是以勝利收場。隋軍突破高句麗第一道防線、攻破若干前線山城之後，被游騎與斷糧戰術釘在遼河以南，糧秣耗盡、久雨困營，只能退兵，退兵途中殿軍又受追擊，一場真正會戰始終沒有發生。決定結局的是桌面上的外交：高句麗國王高元遣使請和，並把楊玄感部的逃將斛斯政送還，隋煬帝在眼見戰事無望、國內又暗潮洶湧的形勢下接受了請和，下令班師。隋軍確實退出了高句麗境內，兩國恢復了此前的對等狀態，平壤與北方山區的防線大致完好。但高元沒有依約出城謁見、正式稱臣，這在高句麗一方看來是拒絕臣服的合理表態，在隋煬帝看來卻是羞辱；他怒而欲再舉東征，經群臣苦勸才作罷。需要說明的是，漢文記載（《資治通鑑》《隋書·高麗傳》）對這一役的進程另有說法，認為隋軍曾直趨平壤城下，因久雨糧盡而退；學界多以大業十年隋軍僅突破第一道防線、未能遠越遼河為主，兩說尚有分歧，可以並存。無論取哪一說，高句麗的答案是清楚的：它守住了，而隋朝在付出第三次傾國代價之後，仍舊一無所獲。
resultEn: It ended, and it ended with a withdrawal rather than a victory. After breaking through Goguryeo's first line of defence and carrying several frontier strongholds, the Sui army was pinned south of the Liao river by the enemy's raiding cavalry and its destruction of the supply lines; with the grain exhausted and the rains confining the camps, there was nothing to do but march out, and the rearguard was caught on the way, so that a real pitched battle was never fought. What decided the outcome was diplomacy across a table: King Go-won sent an envoy to sue for peace and handed back Husi Zheng, the fugitive general of Yang Xuangan, and Emperor Yang, seeing that the war was going nowhere and that the empire was seething at home, accepted the offer and ordered the host to stand down. The Sui army did withdraw from Goguryeo's territory; the two states returned to the parity that had existed before, and the defences of Pyongyang and of the northern hills were substantially intact. But Go-won did not come out of his city to pay the court and acknowledge himself a subject; to Goguryeo this was a reasonable refusal to submit, to Emperor Yang it was an insult, and he ragingly wanted to march east again, and only the pleading of his ministers stopped him. It should be said that the Chinese records — the Zizhi Tongjian and the Goguryeo chapter of the Book of Sui — tell the course of this campaign differently, holding that the Sui army drove straight to Pyongyang and was driven back by the long rains and by want of grain; most modern scholarship takes the view that in 614 the Sui army broke only the first line of defence and did not advance far beyond the Liao river, and the two readings can stand side by side. On either reading the answer from Goguryeo is the same: it held, and the Sui, after paying the third of its enormous bills, came away with nothing.
